char_7.name: Fallen Knight
char_7.flavor: An oathbreaker who found a new master in the dark.

char_8.name: Dungeon Merchant
char_8.flavor: A greedy peddler of cursed surface goods.

char_9.name: The Abyssal Warden
char_9.flavor: An ancient evil stirred from its long slumber.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A knight in <shattered/rusted/black> plate armor kneels before you. His eyes glow with a cold, blue <fire/light>. Accept his vow?
A jingling caravan stops at the gate. A merchant with <greedy/shifty> eyes offers to sell us surface treasures.
The room <shakes/freezes/darkens>. A voice from the deepest Abyss fills your <mind/soul/head>. It demands to be heard.
My former <brothers/kin/friends> seek to redeem me. Let me crush them to prove my eternal loyalty.
A paladin of the [[Order of the Light]] approaches the dungeon alone. I request the honor of a <formal/fair> duel.

dialogues.text: It absorbs the light, much like my crushing, endless <despair/sorrow>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My rusted armor reminds me of my failure to the light. Forge me a new suit of <dark/black> steel.
The goblins lack discipline. They are <pathetic/weak>. Let me train them… brutally.
My spiked armor of eternal suffering is <chafing/rubbing> terribly. May I line the interior with velvet?
The Paladins sent me a bouquet of holy warding-garlic to ‘cure’ me. It smells… <delicious/savory>. What do I do?

dialogues.text: His resolve is weak, but his heart is still stubbornly <pure/clean>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A squire from the [[Order of the Light]] is weeping in the dungeons. He looks like my <son/brother>… let him go?
The Goblins mock my vows of dark chivalry. They do not understand the <tragic/sad> etiquette of a proper duel.

dialogues.text: Her name is <Buttercup/Daisy>, and she is a terror on the battlefield.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I wish to mount an expedition to retrieve my old horse’s skeleton and reanimate it as my <steed/mount>.
My old holy sword burns my hand, but it is a mastercrafted weapon. Melt it into <spikes/nails>?
I attempted to teach the Swarm the ‘Shield Wall’ formation. They used the shields as <sleds/boards> to race down the lava chutes.

dialogues.text: You could comfortably rest a baby on them. It’s <humiliating/insulting>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I am undone. The spikes on your ‘Iron Maiden’ are too <blunt/dull> to provide a truly soulful experience.
Honor is a fine thing, but it doesn’t stop an Orc from gutting you. Let me teach the Swarm to fight ‘<dirty/cheap>.’
The paladins left a cursed mirror at our gates that reflects one’s truest <regrets/fears>. The Orcs are staring into it and weeping. Smash it?
The gold vault ceiling is collapsing. We must brace it immediately. Do we use expensive [[Black Iron]] beams, or stack <goblin bodies/corpses>?

dialogues.text: It makes you incredibly wealthy, but terribly <paranoid/anxious>. A bargain!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Friend, pal! I have a rare, cursed artifact from the surface. Yours for a bag of <gold/coins>.

dialogues.text: They taste like vinegar and occasionally cause spontaneous <combustion/explosions>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Got a fresh shipment of healing potions! They are slightly <expired/old>, but cheap!
I found a map to a hidden vein of dark iron. I need <funding/gold> to start the mining operation.
The [[Shadow Priest]] owes me coin for incense. Collect it for me, and I’ll <cut you in/share>.
I am selling naming rights to the new slime pits. Interested in the ‘Overlord’s Vats of <Agony/Screams>’ package?
I’ve devised a multi-tiered scheme involving cursed wishing coins. Want in on the <ground floor/bottom>?
Business is slow. Let’s install a <Gift Shop/Store> at the end of the Hall of Screams. Tourists love keychains.

dialogues.text: Uruks aren’t known for their financial literacy. <Yes/Absolutely>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I’m introducing ‘Non-Fungible Trinkets.’ It’s just regular rocks, but I tell the Uruks they are <rare/valuable>.

nextCard.cardText: The Uruks quickly realized the rocks are everywhere. They are now throwing the ‘currency’ at my head.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Inflation has hit the dungeon. A single bowl of [[Rat-Stew]] now costs <40/50> gold pieces. Do we fix prices?
I want to sell ‘Mystery Loot Boxes’ to the [[Vanguard]]. It’s mostly just rusty <spoons/nails>.
A noble from the surface wants to buy a timeshare in our torture chambers for his ‘<vacations/holidays>.’
I’m offering ‘Disruption Insurance.’ If a Hero clears a floor, I pay you out. Premium is just a few <chests/bags> of gold.
I have a crate of ‘Tactical Glitter.’ Throw it at a Hero to reveal their invisible armor… or just make them <fabulous/sparkle>.
I’ve imported some ‘Premium [[Cimmerian Fog]].’ It’s thick enough to choke a dragon and hides the unsightly lack of <cobwebs/skulls> in the hallway.
A shipment of ‘Anti-Paladin Repellent’ arrived. It’s mostly just garlic and offensive jokes about the [[Sun-King]]. Want the ‘Premium’ batch?

dialogues.text: Stringy, but they come with their own seasoning. Mostly <lint/dust>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A surface village sent a diplomat. They will pay us a monthly gold tribute if we sign a contract agreeing to only eat their <elderly/old>.
I have a map to the [[Sun-King]]’s supply lines. Give me half the Swarm to dig a tunnel, and we will bleed his caravans dry.
MY SEALS ARE <WEAKENING/FAILING>. THE HORRORS YEARN FOR FREEDOM.

dialogues.text: IT LIKES THE REFLECTIONS OF THE <DROWNING/DEAD>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: THE DEEP WATER… IT HUNGERS FOR THE <SHINY METAL/GOLD>. ==FEED IT.==
THE LITTLE GREEN ONES MULTIPLY TOO FAST. THEY MAKE GOOD KINDLING FOR [[The Deep Flame]].

dialogues.text: I SEE A DIMENSION OF INFINITE SPREADSHEETS AND CUBICLES. TRULY <TERRIFYING/AWFUL>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A RIFT IN REALITY OPENS IN THE [[Catacombs]]. PEER INSIDE?

nextCard.cardText: THREE GOBLINS LOOKED INTO THE RIFT AND INSTANTLY FORMED AN HR DEPARTMENT. MORALE HAS PLUMMETED.

DECK_JSON.prompt: THE MORTALS HAVE INVENTED ‘PAPER MONEY’. IT LACKS THE TASTE OF SOULS. SHALL WE BURN THEIR BANKS?
MY TENTACLES ARE TANGLED IN THE LEY-LINES. THE WARLOCKS ARE <RIOTING/UPSET> OVER THE MAGICAL INTERFERENCE.
==THE VOICES== TELL ME YOU ARE JUST A REFLECTION IN A CRYSTAL SLAB HELD BY A GIANT. BREAK THE SLAB?
REALITY IS THINNING IN THE LOWER DEPTHS. GEOMETRY NO LONGER MAKES <SENSE/LOGIC>. CHARGE ADMISSION?
I HAVE ADOPTED A MORTAL KITTEN. IF ANYONE HARMS IT, I WILL UNMAKE THE CONCEPT OF <TIME/SPACE>.
THE STARS ARE WRONG TODAY. I WISH TO SLEEP FOR A <THOUSAND/MILLION> YEARS. DO NOT WAKE ME.
AN EXISTENTIAL DREAD HAS GRIPPED MY PERCEPTION OF THE HORDE. THEY REALIZE THEIR LIVES ARE JUST <NUMBERS/STATS>.
I HAVE FOUND THE END OF THE <SCRIPT/GAME>. BEYOND THIS CARD LIES ONLY THE BLANK WHITE VOID OF AN UNPAID DEVELOPER’S AMBITION.
THE VOICES IN THE WALLS COMPLAIN THAT THE DUNGEON IS BECOMING ‘QUITE <GENTRIFIED/CLEAN>.’ THEY PREFERRED IT WHEN THE FLOOR WAS MOSTLY BLOOD AND FILTH.
A GUST OF BITTER, FRIGID AIR HAS SWEPT THE CATACOMBS. IT FEELS LIKE THE COLD EMBRACE OF A FORGOTTEN <ANCESTOR/GHOST>. DELIGHTFUL, ISN’T IT?
MY TENTACLES ARE ROTTING FROM THE DAMP. I REQUIRE FRESH LIMBS. SHALL I TAKE THEM FROM THE ORCS OR THE <GOBLINS/SWARM>?
THE LEY-LINES ARE SHIFTING. IF YOU DO NOT FEED ME YOUR FINEST MEAT, I WILL REARRANGE THE STAIRS SO THEY ONLY GO <DOWN/UP>.
